name: Yul-Gok
meaning: Named after the philosopher and scholar Yi I (1536-1584), nicknamed the 'Confucius of Korea'. The 38 movements refer to the 38 degrees latitude of his birthplace, and the diagram represents a scholar.
endingPosition: Bring the left foot back to a ready posture
diagram: Floor diagram image shaped to represent a 'scholar', with points A to F and diagonals such as AD and BD.
